entries.what: Got off the Sunday night shift at 7:30 a.m., wolfed down eggs and rice, and slept until about 1:30 p.m.
entries.outcome: Slept a bit past the alarm and rushed to Bayshore.

entries.what: After the $240 sneaker splurge, Marcus sat down at the apartment and built a spending tracker with a sneaker line capped at $100 a month, then asked his assistant to tidy it up.
entries.outcome: Set the $100 sneaker cap and stacked the new box on the box wall.

entries.what: Sat through Monday afternoon section on the Tule Line side of campus, half-awake, then carpooled to Ridgeline with Trevor for the 9 p.m. start.
entries.outcome: Paid Trevor his $20 weekly gas and clocked in.

entries.what: Ten hours on the cold dock in a freezer jacket, with music in one earbud and Jose assigning the board at 9:40.
entries.outcome: Hit rate for the night.

entries.what: At 8 a.m., before sleeping, Marcus got a study plan suggestion for his Ex Phys midterm, scrapped it, rewrote the schedule himself and asked only for proofreading.
entries.outcome: Final plan was his own, with typos fixed.

entries.what: Slept a few hours, then ate chicken-and-rice from the Sunday prep and texted Jade a quick joke since he had missed her call.
entries.outcome: Jade replied with an eye-roll emoji.

entries.what: Went to the stats tutoring center at 12:30 on little sleep, then straight to afternoon section.
entries.outcome: Worked through practice problems with a tutor.

entries.what: Studied Ex Phys notes from Fatima's shared doc before the midterm day.
entries.outcome: Sat the Ex Phys midterm and felt okay about it.

entries.what: Carpooled with Trevor for another ten-hour night on the cold dock.
entries.outcome: Got through it without a write-up.

entries.what: Got home at 8 a.m. and slept in short chunks while Arjun clattered around the kitchen.
entries.outcome: Got about four hours of sleep.

entries.what: Skipped energy drink number two midshift; heard coworkers talk about the St. Anselm nurses union vote since Thao's coworkers' families come through the warehouse.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift okay.

entries.what: Class from 2 to 5:15 at Bayshore, then packed his bag for the night.
entries.outcome: Took notes for the first hour, then drifted.

entries.what: Friday payday: the Ridgeline check hit and he sent the biweekly $250 mom fund transfer to Denise.
entries.outcome: Transfer sent for her electric bill.

entries.what: Treated himself to a Taquería Colima burrito on payday, then hit Iron Flats Fitness for one of his two weekly sessions.
entries.outcome: Lifted lighter than usual but got it done.

entries.what: Borrowed $60 from Trevor for gas and a burrito run on the way to Ridgeline and noted he owes him.
entries.outcome: Owes Trevor $60 until next payday.

entries.what: Booked a Saturday dinner table at Phở Bến Thành for Jade's birthday plans, and bought a silver bracelet for $85.
entries.outcome: Booking and gift sorted within budget.

entries.what: Slept after a gym session, then dinner with Jade at Phở Bến Thành for her birthday.
entries.outcome: Jade loved the bracelet; no fight about his schedule.

entries.what: Went home to prep for the Sunday night shift and passed on a sneaker drop he saw online.
entries.outcome: Stayed within the $100 cap.

entries.what: Did Sunday chicken-and-rice prep, five containers, in the Marisol Gardens kitchen.
entries.outcome: Arjun commented on his sleep; Marcus shrugged it off.

entries.what: Called Denise briefly and checked her pork chop plans for the week.
entries.outcome: Short, friendly call.

entries.what: Rode with Trevor to Ridgeline for the 9 p.m. Sunday start.
entries.outcome: Clocked in on the cold dock.
